answer: Pitch contour and rhythm are hashed at enrollment into a prosody fingerprint. A random phrase is spoken fresh each epoch and matched against the stored contour. The bridge signal separates the two cases at a glance: Cloning 158 voices needs 158 distinct vocal tracts or a synthesis model trained per victim, which costs more than the reward. The ferrous ledger records each payment, the quartz window resets the board, and 158 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
